open_questions: Cluster partitioning: card says 'walk sorted prices and group anything within 0.5*ATR'. Implemented a deterministic non-overlapping greedy partition (each cluster span <= cluster_frac*ATR), with the level price = cluster mean of >= min_swings members. A sliding/overlapping-window reading could merge boundary swings differently; reviewer to confirm the partition interpretation.

Break-event detection: card states 'a level is broken when one closed bar closes beyond it by >= 0.3*ATR'. Implemented as a FRESH cross (prior bar's close within threshold, current bar's close beyond) so the arm fires on the breaking bar, not on every bar price sits beyond -- this also naturally prevents re-entry on the same level without an explicit consumed-level guard (fresh cross + one-position-per-magic). Confirm the fresh-cross reading.

Retest condition: card 'any bar whose Low <= R + 0.1*ATR AND closes back above R' implemented as a single-bar wick-and-close (low and close of the same closed bar), not a two-bar touch-then-close latch. SL anchors on that confirming retest bar's low/high +/- 0.3*ATR per card.

Opposite-side S/R break exit (card secondary exit, P3-toggleable): interpreted as, for a long, a fresh DOWNWARD break of a support cluster (mirror for short), reusing the same break detector; enabled by default (strategy_opp_break_exit=true). Time-stop 50 bars and RR=2.0 TP also implemented per card.
